Windows install script for pdf-brain (github.com/joelhooks/pdf-brain). Builds from source via Bun rather than the compiled binary, which has a missing libsql native module on Windows. Also auto-installs the other dependencies missing by default on Windows: Poppler (PDF extraction), uv (Python interpreter for pypdf), and Ollama (embeddings), all via winget where possible. See the accompanying PR for the two underlying bug fixes this works around: https://github.com/joelhooks/pdf-brain/pull/16
